related.title: 光回損 ORL：反射功率的符號陷阱
related.titleEn: Optical return loss: reflected-power sign conventions
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學特徵DGD預算1.5 ps；100 km名義通過、400 km不通過；仍需分布尾端驗證。 pmd_sections.csv、DGD分布摘要與模型假設表 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 1 與變更 2 ps、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching characteristic-DGD budget1.5 ps:100 km passes and400 km fails, while tail behavior still requires verification. pmd_sections.csv, DGD distribution summary and model assumptions Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 1 and changed 2 ps, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學ORL至少25 dB；名義通過、變更失敗；不能以20小於30誤判反射變好。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching ORL minimum25 dB: nominal passes and changed fails;20 being smaller than30 is not improved reflection.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成PMD係數0.10 ps/√km；比較100與400 km，偏振統計模型相同。 名義式 0.1*sqrt(100) = 1 ps；變更式 0.1*sqrt(400) = 2 ps。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用多段獨立DGD平方相加再開根號回查；另列樣本分布與分位數，禁止把均方值當峰值。
合成入射1 mW；回返0.001 mW改0.01 mW；只有回返功率改變。 名義式 -10*log10(0.001/1) = 30 dB；變更式 -10*log10(0.01/1) = 20 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將30和20 dB回算為0.1%和1%反射；確認功率計噪底低於回返值且未飽和。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic PMD coefficient0.10 ps/√km; compare100 and400 km using the same polarization-statistics model. Nominal 0.1*sqrt(100) = 1 ps; changed 0.1*sqrt(400) = 2 ps. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Cross-check root-sum-square contributions from independent sections; retain the sample distribution and quantiles rather than treating a characteristic value as the peak.

Synthetic incident power1 mW; reflected power changes from0.001 to0.01 mW with the incident reference fixed. Nominal -10*log10(0.001/1) = 30 dB; changed -10*log10(0.01/1) = 20 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Invert30 and20 dB to0.1% and1% reflection; check that returned power exceeds the noise floor and avoids saturation.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: EDFA 串接：ASE 雜訊累積
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學特徵DGD預算1.5 ps；100 km名義通過、400 km不通過；仍需分布尾端驗證。 pmd_sections.csv、DGD分布摘要與模型假設表 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 1 與變更 2 ps、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。

Teaching characteristic-DGD budget1.5 ps:100 km passes and400 km fails, while tail behavior still requires verification. pmd_sections.csv, DGD distribution summary and model assumptions Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 1 and changed 2 ps, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學OSNR至少22 dB；4段通過、8段不足；多段不等增益時必須改用逐段模型。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching minimum OSNR22 dB:4 spans pass and8 fail; unequal gains require a span-by-span model.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成PMD係數0.10 ps/√km；比較100與400 km，偏振統計模型相同。 名義式 0.1*sqrt(100) = 1 ps；變更式 0.1*sqrt(400) = 2 ps。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用多段獨立DGD平方相加再開根號回查；另列樣本分布與分位數，禁止把均方值當峰值。
合成單段OSNR為30 dB、同一參考頻寬；比較4與8等效段，不計非線性雜訊。 名義式 30-10*log10(4) = 23.9794 dB；變更式 30-10*log10(8) = 20.9691 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 將每段雜訊轉線性相加後回dB；把參考頻寬與訊號量測頻寬單獨列出。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic PMD coefficient0.10 ps/√km; compare100 and400 km using the same polarization-statistics model. Nominal 0.1*sqrt(100) = 1 ps; changed 0.1*sqrt(400) = 2 ps. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Cross-check root-sum-square contributions from independent sections; retain the sample distribution and quantiles rather than treating a characteristic value as the peak.

Synthetic single-span OSNR30 dB in the same reference bandwidth; compare4 and8 equivalent spans, neglecting nonlinear noise. Nominal 30-10*log10(4) = 23.9794 dB; changed 30-10*log10(8) = 20.9691 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Sum linear noise powers then return to dB; distinguish the noise reference bandwidth from signal integration bandwidth.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
